component.name: Universe Desktop
component.summary: Play every game you own, from any store or emulator

description.p: Universe Desktop is the mouse and keyboard face of Universe: one library for your GOG games, the ones Lutris knows, the games in your emulators’ folders and anything added by hand. Each game runs with the settings you give it, its runner’s or everyone’s, inside gamescope when you want it there.

ul.li: A grid of covers with every source and platform in the sidebar, search, sorting and hidden games
GOG installs, updates and resumed downloads from the Store
Screenshots, recordings played in the app, and the journal written after each session
Achievements, every session with its log, and word when a game crashes
Artwork from the stores, GOG GamesDB and libretro, or your own pictures, and the controller set up on a live drawing of the pad
Games found and started from the GNOME Shell search
